title: A missing move rejects on the spot
notes: This DFA accepts the words that start with ab, and it leaves out every move that could never lead to acceptance. On ba there is no move from q0 on b, so the run stops at the first symbol and rejects. abba is read to the end and accepted.
ops: start q0; accept q2; q0 a -> q1; q1 b -> q2; q2 a,b -> q2
